info.title: PricePilot API
info.description: Professional-grade API for automated e-commerce price monitoring and dynamic pricing management. Access your products, competitors, price approvals, and market intelligence programmatically.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key for authentication. Generate from your dashboard under Settings > API Keys.

examples.error: Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.

password: Password must be at least 8 characters

product_ids: At least one product ID is required

status.description: Price status: RED (competitor cheaper), GREEN (you're cheaper), NEUTRAL (same price), COMP_OOS (competitor out of stock), NOT_FOUND (no match)

isAdvancedProtected.description: Whether site has advanced bot protection

apiKey.description: API Key authentication using x-api-key header

session.description: Session-based authentication for web application (cookie automatically sent by browser)

curl.description: Example cURL request with API key authentication

tags.name: Matching
tags.description: Product matching between your catalog and competitors

tags.name: Approval Delegation
tags.description: Delegate price approval authority to team members

post.description: Create a new user account and tenant. This endpoint is rate-limited to prevent abuse.

example.error: User with this email already exists
Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of your products with competitor price comparisons. Supports filtering, searching, and sorting.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query (searches title, SKU, brand, model)

competitorOos.description: Products where competitor is out of stock

example.error: Rate limit exceeded. Please try again in 60 seconds.

get.description: Returns all competitor websites you're tracking with their sync status and product counts.

post.description: Add a new competitor website to track. The system will automatically start scraping products.

searchQueryPattern.description: Optional search query pattern for advanced scraping

example.error: Competitor tracking limit reached (5). Please upgrade your plan to track more sites.

url: URL must start with http:// or https://

delete.description: Remove a competitor from tracking. This will delete all associated products and matches.

get.description: Get all pending price changes awaiting approval. Supports pagination and status filtering.

status: Invalid status value. Must be one of: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, EXPIRED

post.description: Approve or reject one or more pending price changes. Approved changes will be pushed to your store.

400.description: Bad request - Some changes not found or already processed

get.description: Get all connected e-commerce platforms (your stores).

post.description: Connect a new e-commerce platform. Requires API token from your store.

apiToken.description: API token from your store (will be encrypted)

example.error: Store connection limit reached. Please upgrade your plan.

platform: Invalid platform. Must be one of: OPENCART, LARAVEL

apiToken: Invalid API token or unable to connect to store

delete.description: Disconnect an e-commerce platform. This will delete all associated products.

get.description: Get all pending product matches awaiting approval. These are automatically generated matches between your products and competitor products.

post.description: Approve or reject a product match. Approved matches will be used for price comparisons.

action: Invalid action. Must be one of: APPROVE, REJECT

example.error: Failed to process match action. Please try again.

post.description: Execute bulk price updates for multiple products. Updates are applied immediately to your store.

product_ids.description: Array of product IDs to update

value.description: Value for the strategy (e.g., 50 for $50 undercut, 10 for 10% discount)

product_ids: At least one product ID is required

logic_type: Invalid pricing strategy. Must be one of: UNDERCUT, MATCH, PERCENTAGE, FIXED

post.description: Trigger a full competitive sync: scrape competitors, match products, calculate price changes. This is a long-running operation.

get.description: Returns all auto-approval rules for the authenticated tenant, ordered by priority.

post.description: Creates a new auto-approval rule with specified conditions. All conditions must be satisfied for auto-approval (AND logic).

get.description: Returns a single auto-approval rule by ID.

put.description: Updates an existing auto-approval rule. All fields are optional.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an auto-approval rule. This action cannot be undone.

get.description: Get real-time aggregated stats of your market position.

marketEdge.description: Percentage of products where you're competitive

get.description: Retrieves rollback history for the authenticated tenant. Shows all price changes and bulk operations that have been rolled back.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of history records to return

post.summary: Rollback price change or bulk operation
post.description: Rollback a single price change or an entire bulk operation. The rollback will revert prices to their previous values and sync the changes to your store. Supports both single price change rollback (via updateLogId) and bulk operation rollback (via snapshotId).

updateLogId.description: ID of the price update log to rollback (for single price change)

snapshotId.description: ID of the bulk operation snapshot to rollback (for bulk operation)

get.description: Returns all approval delegations for the authenticated tenant. Shows both active and expired delegations.

post.description: Delegate price approval authority to another user for a specified time period. The delegated user will be able to approve price changes on your behalf.

toUserId.description: ID of the user to delegate to

endDate: End date must be after start date

toUserId: User not found or not in your tenant

patch.description: Update the start and end dates of an existing delegation. Can only update delegations that belong to your tenant.

startDate.description: New delegation start date and time

endDate.description: New delegation end date and time

endDate: End date must be after start date

delete.description: Permanently revoke an approval delegation. The delegated user will immediately lose approval authority. This action cannot be undone.

FORBIDDEN.description: Insufficient permissions or resource limit reached

CONFLICT.description: Resource already exists or operation conflicts with current state

RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: Too many requests. Rate limit exceeded.

ROLLBACK_NOT_ALLOWED.description: Rollback operation is not allowed for this resource
